salaryCalculator.pageDescription: See what you actually take home under an employment contract in Portugal — real 2026 withholding tables and IRS brackets, updated for Continente, Madeira and Açores.
salaryCalculator.pageIntro: Figures are estimates based on the official 2026 withholding tables and IRS brackets in force for the month you select. This doesn't replace payroll processing or tax advice.
salaryCalculator.maritalStatusHint: Single and "married, two earners" are withheld identically month-to-month — Portuguese tables treat each earner as if single. Any joint-taxation benefit only applies to the annual tax return.
salaryCalculator.disabilityAbove60Hint: Your own disability — it selects a more favourable withholding table and changes your monthly net.
salaryCalculator.flatRate20: I'm on the flat 20% regime (IFICI / legacy RNH)
salaryCalculator.paymentsPerYearHint: Your monthly take-home is the same either way — this only changes your annual total and whether the holiday/Christmas subsidies are paid as lump sums or spread monthly (duodécimos, below).
salaryCalculator.twelfthsOptionNone: Paid in June and December, as usual
salaryCalculator.twelfthsOptionHalf: Half spread monthly, half paid as usual
salaryCalculator.exemptAmountHint: Not subject to IRS or Social Security — enter the monthly amount.
salaryCalculator.irsApplicableAmountHint: Subject to IRS, but exempt from Social Security — enter the monthly amount.
salaryCalculator.ctaCreateAccount: Create a free account to save your searches and apply faster
salaryCalculator.disclaimer: Estimated values based on the withholding tables and tax rules in force for the period selected. This doesn't replace payroll processing or professional tax advice.
salaryCalculator.resultError: Couldn't calculate a result for these inputs — try adjusting them.
salaryCalculator.breakdownFlatRateNote: A flat 20% IFICI/RNH withholding rate applies — no bracket table is used.
salaryCalculator.freelanceDaysPerYearHint: No official default exists for this — 220 is a placeholder assumption (roughly 11 months worked, holidays and bench time already netted out).
salaryCalculator.freelanceActivityType: What kind of work do you do?
salaryCalculator.freelanceActivityTypeHint: Affects your tax coefficient and withholding rate — most IT freelance work (development, programming, consulting) falls under the first option.
salaryCalculator.freelanceMonthsSinceStart: How many months have you been doing this activity?
salaryCalculator.freelanceMonthsSinceStartHint: The first 12 months are exempt from Social Security contributions, and your tax coefficient is reduced in your first two years.
salaryCalculator.freelanceAlsoEmployedHint: Only affects whether you might be exempt from Social Security on this income — your IRS estimate below covers this freelance income only, not your other job.
salaryCalculator.freelanceDeclaredExpensesHint: Most freelancers can leave this at 0 — a standard deduction is already applied automatically. Only fill this in if your real business expenses and Social Security payments are unusually high.
salaryCalculator.freelanceWithholdingWaiver: Ask clients not to withhold IRS from my invoices
salaryCalculator.freelanceWithholdingWaiverHint: Only available while you expect to invoice under €15,000 this year — stops applying automatically once you cross it.
salaryCalculator.freelanceGlossarySsDefinition: A monthly contribution independent workers pay themselves — 21.4% of 70% of what you invoice. Unlike employees, no employer pays a share of it.
salaryCalculator.freelanceGlossaryCatBDefinition: The tax category for self-employed income (Categoria A is for employees). Under the simplified regime, only a percentage of what you invoice counts as taxable — 75% for technical/IT services, 35% for other services.
salaryCalculator.freelanceGlossaryVatDefinition: A sales tax you may need to add to invoices and pass on to the tax authority — it's never part of your own income. You may be exempt if you invoice under €15,000/year.
salaryCalculator.freelanceGlossaryWithholdingDefinition: Portuguese clients deduct a percentage of each invoice upfront as an advance on your yearly IRS bill — not an extra tax, just paid earlier. Foreign clients don't withhold, which is why it's worth setting money aside yourself.
salaryCalculator.freelanceCashInHand: {amount} actually lands in your account this month
salaryCalculator.freelanceReserveHint: Estimated annual IRS liability ÷ 12 — set this aside each month, especially if your clients don't withhold Portuguese tax.

flagNote.SS_EXEMPT_FIRST_12_MONTHS: Exempt from Social Security — within your first 12 months of activity.
flagNote.SS_EXEMPT_ACUMULACAO: Exempt from Social Security — your relevant income stays under the acumulação threshold while also employed.
flagNote.SS_MAXIMUM_BASE_APPLIED: Your Social Security contribution is capped at the maximum base (12× IAS).
flagNote.NO_WITHHOLDING_FOREIGN_CLIENT: No Portuguese IRS withholding on this invoice — foreign clients don't withhold PT tax. All IRS is paid at the annual settlement.
flagNote.IFICI_FLAT_WITHHOLDING: Flat 20% IFICI/RNH withholding applied instead of the normal Cat B rate.
flagNote.WITHHOLDING_WAIVER_APPLIED: No IRS withheld — dispensa de retenção applied, since your expected annual income stays under €15,000.
flagNote.ART53_THRESHOLD_LIKELY_EXCEEDED: Your invoicing looks like it would cross the art. 53º turnover threshold — double-check your VAT exemption still applies.
flagNote.REVERSE_CHARGE_EU: Reverse charge — no Portuguese VAT on this invoice; your EU client accounts for it.
flagNote.OUTSIDE_SCOPE_NON_EU_VAT: Outside the scope of Portuguese VAT — no VAT charged on this invoice.
flagNote.ANNUAL_IRS_UNAVAILABLE_REGION: Annual IRS brackets for Madeira/Açores aren't available yet — the tax reserve estimate falls back to what's actually being withheld.

salaryCalculator.companyGerenteExemptViaOtherActivity: I'm covered by another mandatory Social Security regime (e.g. employed elsewhere)
salaryCalculator.companyGerenteExemptViaOtherActivityHint: An unpaid gerente already covered elsewhere, earning above 1× IAS there, is exempt from the gerente Social Security obligation.
salaryCalculator.companyMunicipalSurchargeRateHint: Set by each município, 0% to 1.5%. 1.5% is the common ceiling and default.
salaryCalculator.companyIsSme: My company qualifies as an SME (PME)
salaryCalculator.companyDistributeAllProfit: Distribute all net profit as dividends
salaryCalculator.companyLegalReserveNote: A Lda must also retain a legal reserve (5% of profit until it reaches 20% of share capital) — not modeled here; talk to your accountant.
salaryCalculator.employmentInfoWithholdingDefinition: The IRS deducted from your payslip each month is an advance, not a final bill. Your real yearly IRS liability is only settled when you file your annual tax return — it can come out higher or lower than what was withheld, depending on deductions, other income, and your exact household situation.
salaryCalculator.employmentInfoRightsTerm: A contract gives you more than a salary
salaryCalculator.employmentInfoRightsDefinition: Beyond the net figure above, an employment contract also gives you paid holidays, sick pay from Social Security, unemployment benefit eligibility if you're later laid off, parental leave, a statutory notice period, and severance pay if your employer ends the contract. None of that applies to Recibos Verdes or running your own company.
salaryCalculator.employmentInfoContractTypesDefinition: Contrato sem termo (permanent, open-ended) is the norm and gives you the strongest protection. Contrato a termo (fixed-term) can usually only be renewed a limited number of times before it must convert to permanent or end. Most contracts include a short probation period at the start, during which either side can end it with little or no notice.
salaryCalculator.freelancePitfallForeignClientsTerm: Foreign clients don't withhold Portuguese tax
salaryCalculator.freelancePitfallForeignClientsDefinition: If your clients are outside Portugal, nothing is deducted upfront — you still owe the same IRS at the end of the year. Set aside the recommended monthly reserve above yourself; it's easy to spend money that isn't really yours yet.
salaryCalculator.freelancePitfallThresholdTerm: The €15,000 threshold shows up twice, for different things
salaryCalculator.freelancePitfallThresholdDefinition: Invoicing under €15,000/year can qualify you for both VAT exemption and the IRS withholding waiver — but they're separate elections, and crossing the threshold during the year can switch off either one immediately.
salaryCalculator.freelancePitfallQuarterlyTerm: Social Security is declared quarterly, not monthly
salaryCalculator.freelancePitfallQuarterlyDefinition: Portugal sets your Social Security contribution base once per quarter, from your average invoicing over the previous three months — this calculator shows a simplified monthly estimate based on your current invoicing.
salaryCalculator.freelancePitfallNoRightsTerm: You don't get an employee's protections
salaryCalculator.freelancePitfallNoRightsDefinition: No paid holidays, no employer-paid sick leave, no unemployment benefit by default, no severance pay. That's the real trade-off against the lower monthly deductions.
salaryCalculator.companyInfoAccountantDefinition: A Lda is legally required to keep organised accounts reviewed by a certified accountant (contabilista certificado) — a real, mandatory monthly cost, already included above.
salaryCalculator.companyInfoLegalReserveDefinition: By law, a Lda must retain part of its profit each year as a legal reserve (5%, until it reaches 20% of share capital) before the rest can be distributed as dividends — this calculator doesn't subtract it, so treat the dividend figures above as a ceiling, not a guarantee.
salaryCalculator.companyInfoSalaryVsDividendsTerm: Salary vs. dividends is a real trade-off
salaryCalculator.companyInfoSalaryVsDividendsDefinition: Gerente salary is taxed like any employee's and builds your Social Security record; dividends are taxed at a flat 28% with no Social Security at all, but don't count toward your pension or benefit eligibility. Most owners use a mix of both.
salaryCalculator.companyInfoIrcScheduleTerm: IRC is falling in future years
salaryCalculator.companyInfoIrcScheduleDefinition: The current 15%/19% SME rate is scheduled to drop to 18% in 2027 and 17% from 2028 — not reflected here, since this calculator always uses the rate for the year you select.

privacy.intro: This Privacy Policy explains what personal data Just IT collects, why, and what rights you have over it. It applies to everyone who uses justit.pt, whether as a candidate, an employer, or a visitor browsing job listings.
privacy.controllerBody:
Just IT is operated by PABC. PABC (full legal name: Paulo Adrega Brás Consulting) is a sole proprietorship (jednoosobowa działalność gospodarcza) registered in Poland under NIP 5242876773 and REGON 381799982, active since 3 December 2018, with its registered address at ul. Warszawska 116G, 05-123 Olszewnica Stara, gm. Wieliszew, pow. legionowski, woj. Mazowieckie, Poland. Its owner, Paulo Adrega Brás, is the data controller for the purposes of Article 4(7) GDPR.

Just IT is a Portuguese-market platform: its service, its users, and the employers it verifies are focused on Portugal, even though the operating entity is registered in Poland. For any question about this policy or your personal data, contact us at privacy@justit.pt.
privacy.dataBody:
If you use Just IT as a candidate, we collect:
- Account details: name, email address, phone number, and how you signed up (email/password or a social login such as Google, GitHub, or LinkedIn)
- Profile content: your CV file, LinkedIn URL, profile photo, headline, years of experience, skills, spoken languages, education, work history, and certifications — whichever of these you choose to add, manually or by uploading a CV for our AI-assisted autofill to extract
- Job preferences: preferred categories, locations, work model, employment type, and desired salary range
- Activity data: jobs you apply to or save as a favourite, searches you save, and the messages you exchange with employers
- Marketing preference: whether you've opted in to receive marketing communications from us (off by default)

If you use Just IT as an employer, we collect:
- Company data: legal name, NIF (Portuguese tax/registration number), registered address, and verification status — your NIF may itself be personal data if you're registered as a sole trader, and we never publish it
- Team member data: for each person on your account, their name, profile photo, and phone number, stored against their login and not shared publicly
- Public profile content you choose to add: company description, social links, office location, and — for Top Employer subscribers — an "about us" section, team photos, testimonials, and photo/video galleries
- Billing data: we never see or store your card details; Stripe processes payments directly and we keep only a reference to your Stripe customer/subscription for our own records
- API credentials, if you generate one: we store a cryptographic hash of your API key, never the key itself
privacy.basesHeading: 3. Why we process your data (legal bases)
privacy.basesBody:
We rely on the following legal bases under Article 6(1) of the GDPR:
- Performance of a contract (Art. 6(1)(b)): creating and managing your account, letting employers post jobs and candidates apply to them, and processing payments for ad credits and subscriptions
- Legitimate interests (Art. 6(1)(f)): keeping the platform secure, preventing fraud and abuse, computing job recommendations and (for paying employers) candidate matches from the skills and preferences you've entered, and improving the service
- Consent (Art. 6(1)(a)): sending you marketing communications, only if you've opted in, and you can withdraw this at any time in Settings (Art. 7(3)); and loading Google Analytics, only if you accept it on the cookie banner described in section 4
- Legal obligation (Art. 6(1)(c)): verifying an employer's NIF against the Portuguese tax authorities' VIES/registry systems before a job can be published, consistent with our rule that every employer must be a verified business entity
privacy.cookiesBody:
We use one strictly necessary cookie to keep you signed in, set by our authentication provider (Supabase) and required for the site to know who you are between page loads. Under Article 5(3) of the ePrivacy Directive (2002/58/EC), transposed in Portugal by Lei n.º 41/2004 as amended, this doesn't need your consent, since it's necessary for a service you've explicitly requested. We don't set a separate cookie for your language preference — the language you're reading this in is simply part of the page's own web address.

We also store a small amount of information in your browser's local storage, which isn't a cookie but serves a similarly strictly functional purpose: which job listings you've recently viewed (so we can suggest creating an account after you've looked at a few), whether you've dismissed that suggestion, and, for employers, whether you've dismissed a notification banner in the console. None of it is shared with third parties or used to track you across other websites.

With your consent, we use Google Analytics (GA4) to understand how visitors use justit.pt — page views and aggregated usage patterns, never your name, email, or any field from your profile. Google Analytics sets its own cookies (prefixed `_ga`) and isn't strictly necessary, so under Article 5(3) of the ePrivacy Directive we only load it after you accept it on the cookie banner shown on your first visit; if you reject it or make no choice, Analytics never loads and no Analytics cookie is set. You can change your choice at any time by clearing your browser's local storage for justit.pt and revisiting the site. The legal basis for this specific processing is your consent (Art. 6(1)(a) GDPR), which you may withdraw at any time.
privacy.sharingBody:
We share personal data with the following service providers, each acting on our instructions:
- Supabase (database, authentication, and file storage) — hosts essentially all the data described above
- Stripe (payments) — processes ad-credit and Top Employer subscription payments, and receives the email address you check out with
- Resend (email delivery) — sends transactional emails (application confirmations, new-message notifications, contact-form replies, billing receipts) on our behalf, via Amazon SES
- Vercel (hosting) — runs the application itself
- Upstash (rate limiting) — stores a short-lived counter keyed to your company account, used only to enforce fair-use limits on our public API; entries expire automatically and contain no personal data about you as an individual
- Anthropic, via Vercel's AI Gateway — powers a handful of AI features you choose to use: parsing your CV text when you click "Analyse my CV", polishing a job description an employer has written, and, for paying employers, generating a short AI summary of an applicant's CV against a specific job. We only send the text needed for the feature you triggered, never your account credentials or payment details
- nif.pt, a Portuguese business-registry lookup — receives an employer's NIF during verification, and returns the matching company's registered name and address
- Google (analytics), only if you accept analytics cookies in section 4 — receives aggregated, non-identifying usage data such as which pages are viewed and how often

We never sell personal data, and we never share a candidate's contact details (name, email, phone) with an employer unless the candidate has applied to their job or responded to a message from them.
privacy.transfersBody: Supabase hosts our database in the EU. Stripe, Resend, Vercel, Anthropic, and Google are based in the United States. Where personal data is transferred to them outside the EU/EEA, we rely on the European Commission's Standard Contractual Clauses (Art. 46(2)(c) GDPR), which each of these processors incorporates into its standard data processing terms, as the safeguard for that transfer; Google additionally participates in the EU-U.S. Data Privacy Framework for some of its services. Separately, PABC itself, the entity operating Just IT, is established in Poland rather than Portugal — an intentional, disclosed part of how this business is structured, not a transfer requiring a GDPR Chapter V safeguard, since Poland is an EU member state subject to the same GDPR as Portugal.
privacy.retentionBody: We keep your data for as long as your account is active. If you delete your candidate account, available any time in Settings, we immediately and permanently delete your CV, avatar, skills, education, work history, certifications, favourites, and saved searches, and we anonymise your name, email, and phone number on your remaining account record. We keep that anonymised record because your past applications and message threads are also part of an employer's own hiring records, and deleting it outright would erase their side of that history too. We don't currently offer a self-service deletion option for employer accounts — contact us at privacy@justit.pt and we'll handle the request directly.
privacy.rightsBody:
Under the GDPR, you have the right to access (Art. 15), rectify (Art. 16), erase (Art. 17), restrict (Art. 18), or port (Art. 20) your personal data, to object to our processing of it (Art. 21), and to withdraw any consent you've given us at any time (Art. 7(3)) without affecting the lawfulness of processing before that withdrawal. As a candidate, you can exercise most of these yourself, right now, in Settings: "Download my data" gives you a full export of your profile, applications, favourites, saved searches, and messages, and "Delete my account" anonymises and removes your data as described above. If you're an employer, or need help with anything our self-service tools don't cover, email us at privacy@justit.pt.

You also have the right to lodge a complaint with a supervisory authority (Art. 77 GDPR). As PABC is established in Poland, the competent authority is the Polish Data Protection Authority (UODO — Urząd Ochrony Danych Osobowych, uodo.gov.pl). If you live in Portugal, you may instead, or also, lodge a complaint with the CNPD (www.cnpd.pt), since Article 77 lets you complain to the supervisory authority of your own country of residence regardless of where the controller is established.
privacy.securityBody: We use industry-standard safeguards to protect your data, including encrypted connections, database-level access controls that restrict who can read what, and password handling managed by our authentication provider rather than by us directly. No system is perfectly secure and we can't guarantee absolute security, but we take reasonable technical and organisational measures, as required by Article 32 GDPR, to protect your information.
privacy.changesBody: We may update this policy as the service changes. We'll update the date at the top of this page whenever we do, and for material changes we'll make a reasonable effort to let you know.
privacy.contactBody: Questions about this policy or your data? Email us at privacy@justit.pt.

terms.intro: These Terms of Use govern your access to and use of justit.pt. By creating an account or using the site, you agree to them.
terms.platformBody:
Just IT is a job board connecting IT candidates and employers in Portugal, operated by PABC. PABC (full legal name: Paulo Adrega Brás Consulting) is a sole proprietorship (jednoosobowa działalność gospodarcza) registered in Poland under NIP 5242876773 and REGON 381799982, active since 3 December 2018, with its registered address at ul. Warszawska 116G, 05-123 Olszewnica Stara, gm. Wieliszew, pow. legionowski, woj. Mazowieckie, Poland. Its owner, Paulo Adrega Brás, is the data controller for the purposes of Article 4(7) GDPR.

We provide the platform — we are not an employment agency, we are not a party to any employment contract or freelance arrangement formed between a candidate and an employer, and we don't guarantee that any job will be filled or that any application will lead to an offer. Employers are solely responsible for the jobs they post and the hiring decisions they make; candidates are solely responsible for the accuracy of the information in their profile and applications.
terms.accountsBody: You must provide accurate information when creating an account. If you register as an employer, you must have the authority to act on behalf of the business whose NIF you provide. A single email account on Just IT can hold both a candidate and an employer profile, but acquiring each role still requires going through that role's own registration, including NIF verification for an employer profile.
terms.rulesHeading: 3. The two rules every listing must follow
terms.rulesBody:
Every job listed on Just IT must follow two rules:
- Salary transparency: every job must have a specified salary range before it can be published. A paying employer, one with ad credits or a Top Employer subscription, may choose not to display that range publicly, but the range must still exist and is always visible to us and, where relevant, to applicants through the normal application flow
- Verified employers: every employer must be a real, verified business entity. We verify a company's NIF against the EU VIES system and/or the Portuguese business registry before its first job can go live
terms.obligationsBody:
When using Just IT, you agree not to:
- Post a job listing that doesn't exist, is misleading, or is posted on behalf of a company you're not authorised to represent
- Submit false or misleading information about yourself, your qualifications, or your company
- Use the platform to harass, spam, or send unsolicited commercial messages to other users
- Scrape, systematically download, or republish listings or profile data without our permission
- Attempt to circumvent our verification, security, or payment systems
- Use the platform for any unlawful purpose

If you're an employer and you receive a candidate's personal data through an application or a message, you're responsible for handling that data lawfully and only for the purpose it was shared with you, reviewing that specific candidate for that specific role, and not for anything else.
terms.contentBody: Job descriptions are stored and displayed as plain text; we don't accept or render HTML in a posting. We may remove a listing or other content that violates these Terms or the rules above, without prior notice.
terms.paymentsBody: Ad credits and Top Employer subscriptions are billed through Stripe, at the prices shown at checkout. Subscriptions renew automatically until cancelled; you can manage or cancel a subscription from the billing section of the employer console. We don't currently publish a general refund policy — if something's gone wrong with a purchase, contact us at hello@justit.pt and we'll look at it directly.
terms.ipBody: The Just IT name, logo, and the platform itself belong to PABC. Content you submit, including job postings, your profile, CVs, and messages, remains yours; by submitting it, you grant us the licence we need to store, display, and process it in order to provide the service, for example showing your job listing to candidates, or your profile to an employer you've applied to.
terms.terminationBody: You can stop using Just IT at any time; candidates can delete their account from Settings, as described in our Privacy Policy. We may suspend or terminate an account that violates these Terms, for example a fraudulent job listing, a fake company, or abusive messages, with or without notice, depending on severity.
terms.disclaimerBody: Just IT is provided "as is." We don't guarantee the accuracy of job listings or profile content submitted by other users, and we're not responsible for the outcome of any application, interview, or hiring decision. To the extent permitted by applicable law, PABC isn't liable for indirect, incidental, or consequential damages arising from your use of the platform.
terms.lawBody: PABC, the entity operating Just IT, is a sole proprietorship registered in Poland; the service itself is focused on the Portuguese IT job market. These Terms are governed by the laws of Portugal, consistent with that focus, without prejudice to any mandatory consumer-protection rights you may have under the law of your own country of residence. Any dispute arising from these Terms will be submitted to the exclusive jurisdiction of the Portuguese courts.
terms.changesBody: We may update these Terms as the service changes. We'll update the date at the top of this page whenever we do, and continuing to use Just IT after a change means you accept the updated Terms.
terms.contactBody: Questions about these Terms? Email us at hello@justit.pt.

developers.title: Just IT API
developers.intro: A REST API for Top Employer companies to post, update and manage job ads programmatically — the same actions the console does, without the console.
developers.getKeyIntro: You'll need an active Top Employer subscription and an API key, generated from your own account at
developers.authBody: Send your key as a bearer token on every request.
developers.errorsBody: Every error comes back as JSON with this shape:
developers.referenceBody: Categories, locations, tech tags and spoken languages — as slugs — plus the fixed enums below. Use these slugs when creating or updating a job; you never need this product's internal ids.
developers.listBody: Every job belonging to your company, regardless of status.
developers.detailBody: Same shape as the create/update response below, plus every field of the job.
developers.createBody: Creates a job. Set "publish": true to publish it immediately, or omit it (or set it to false) to save a draft.
developers.updateBody: Same request body as POST — this replaces the whole job, it is not a partial patch. Send every field, not just the ones you're changing.
developers.jobFieldsBody: The request body for POST and PUT.
developers.statusBody: Pause takes a published job down; publish brings a draft or paused job back up (subject to the same ad-credit/Top-Employer allowance the console itself enforces).
developers.deleteBody: Deletes a draft or paused job. A job with any real applications can't be deleted — pause it instead.
